name: SuperStar: The Boyz
summary:
SuperStar THE BOYZ is a vibrant Global K-POP rhythm game designed to engage fans of THE BOYZ with their music in an interactive and dynamic format. Players can immerse themselves in the beats of THE BOYZ, with an array of songs showcasing their diverse appeal, updated on a weekly basis.

Players have the unique opportunity to collect and manage artist cards across various themes, aiming to create the ultimate card deck. Exclusive theme cards are available, adding a collectible element that fans can enjoy. Upgrading these cards plays into the strategy, as achieving a coveted R Grade Card can lead to impressive in-game benefits.

The competitive aspect of this rhythm game allows gamers to participate in the Weekly League, vying for high scores against a community of global K-POP enthusiasts, with the scores determined by the power-up status of your cards.

Missions and events further enrich the gameplay, offering fresh challenges daily and aligning with THE BOYZ's artistic comebacks or concert events, ensuring that the content remains up-to-date and engaging.

The platform prioritizes user convenience and customization, including options to adjust graphic settings to ensure a smooth playing experience.
